resampling.unit: paired utterance; keep all recording variants together

predeclared: Use every exact20 input in all8 members. This supplement specifies the paired bootstrap and metadata join; it does not change candidates, evaluation or admission. Sampling uncertainty is unstable at20 and does not establish reliable benefit. No formal threshold, optimizer update or automatic expansion.
stratum_join: Join only the exact20 sample IDs to their pre-existing Fold-A metadata and verify utterance identity against the pinned analysis roster. Retain only sample_id, utterance_id and stratum; no runtime target supply.
repairs_and_damage: Between complete systems, a whole answer is exact when intent is correct and official exact-entity FP=FN=0; empty correct entities count as correct. This association does not establish a within-trajectory or node causal effect. Separate source-verified role diagnostics are required to explain a mechanism.
read_conditions: Require exact signed READ, eight FINALIZED verified seals,20 rows each, exactly one successful complete official score per member and zero failed jobs. Repackage saved scores only, no scorer call. Preserve immutable sources and ordinary400-row optimizer feedback minimum.
output_boundary: Root-only data-root/analysis derivatives. No pilot feedback to either proposer; no optimizer memory or archive write.
